scripts.generate: npm run generate --workspace @call-calendar/contracts && npm run generate --workspace @call-calendar/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @call-calendar/api && npm run build --workspace @call-calendar/web
scripts.lint: npm run validate:release-please && oxlint . && oxfmt --check . && jactionlint --ignore duplicate-triggers .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @call-calendar/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @call-calendar/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @call-calendar/api && npm run test --workspace @call-calendar/web
scripts.check: npm run generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
